title: yuningyang19/parameter_free_gradient_p
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of three results about exact value-gradient oracle complexity in finite-dimensional l_p geometry: strict-local scale-identification impossibility at fixed LR/epsilon = 4, the known-parameter p > 2 upper/lower exponent p/(p+2) with its stated horizon and dimension qualifications, and a post-secant-initialization parameter-free runtime family with the three p regimes. The Comparator surface contains exactly these three declarations; the other certified results remain supporting proof infrastructure.

formalizes.title: Optimal Parameter-Free Gradient Minimization in l_p Geometry

review.reason: Lean formalization of oracle complexity results for parameter-free gradient methods in l_p geometry.
